name: wisp-science
tagline_zh: 本地跑Python/R，连SSH和GPU，调MCP生物信息工具，还接OpenAI/Anthropic——你的科研桌。
tagline_en: Run Python/R locally, SSH into GPU boxes, plug MCP bio tools, and call OpenAI/Anthropic—your research desk, no.
desc_en: Open-source, local-first desktop AI research workbench for scientific computing with Python/R, MCP bioinformatics tools, SSH/WSL/GPU runtimes, and OpenAI/Anthropic models.
why_zh: 同类多绑云端，它却把本地优先、SSH/GPU和MCP生物工具焊成一套，离线也能改代码，连上就能跑大模型。
why_en: Unlike cloud-locked rivals, it welds local-first, SSH/GPU, and MCP bio tools into one offline-friendly desk—code locally, scale.
